messages.author: 9707fac9ad048016
messages.subject: Can't solve this warning message" covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite;"
parts:
Dear all,

I am new to CFA, and came to learn that when dealing with Likert scale, Lavaan in R is a better tool than Amos to do such analysis.
I have 7 factors and 28 items in Academic motivation (AMS C-28) Likert scale questionnaire. 

I did the following:

CFA_AMS <-'intrinsic_know=~ in_know2 + in_know9 + in_know16 + in_know23
          intrinsic_accomplishment =~ in_accomp6 + in_accomp13 + in_accomp20 + in_accomp27
          intrinsic_experience=~ in_exper4 + in_exper11 + in_exper18 +in_exper25
         
          extrinsic_identified=~  ex_ident3 + ex_ident10 + ex_ident17 + ex_ident24
          extrinsic_introjected=~ ex_introj7 + ex_introj14 + ex_introj21 + ex_introj28
          extrinsic_regulation=~ ex_regula1 + ex_regula8 +  ex_regula15 +  ex_regula22
         
          amotivation=~ amotiv5 + amotiv12 + amotiv19 + amotiv26'  

fit_AMS<-lavaan::cfa(CFA_AMS, estimator="mlr", missing="fiml", data= ams1)
summary(fit_AMS, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE, rsquare=TRUE)

However, I get this warning:
Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables
                is not positive definite;
                use lavInspect(fit, "cov.lv") to investigate.

Following the message I run this
lavInspect(fit_AMS, "cov.lv")
                         intrnsc_k intrnsc_c intrnsc_x extrnsc_d extrnsc_n extrnsc_r amtvtn
intrinsic_know            0.910                                                            
intrinsic_accomplishment  0.915     1.186                                                  
intrinsic_experience      0.594     0.675     0.890                                        
extrinsic_identified      0.514     0.576     0.332     0.661                              
extrinsic_introjected     0.680     1.029     0.506     0.770     1.214                    
extrinsic_regulation      0.381     0.498     0.296     0.741     0.856     1.015          
amotivation              -0.647    -0.725    -0.108    -0.519    -0.633    -0.378     2.071


I would like to know if this warning is an indication that my model is not fit because of the negative result in (amotivation)? If so would you kindly help me to figure it out? 
Is running an EFA and eliminating items will fix the model?

Thank you so much in advance.
Sam

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Can't solve this warning message" covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite;"
parts:
None of the variances are negative, so that is not the problem.  Try lavInspect(fit, "cor.lv") to see if any correlations are beyond +/- 1.  If that is not it either, then it is a less obvious case of linear dependency (e.g. multicollinearity among factors).  There is no way to know whether the same issue will occur in different models (e.g., EFA or less restrictive CFAs), unless you try.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
